name: Energy Break
description: Every encounter drains an opponent's energy, pushing all of their ability cooldowns up by %cooldown_increase%, or by %bonus_increase% on a landed attack.
details: Cooldowns driven up this way can exceed their normal maximum.

upgrade.summary: Landed attacks also deal %bonus_damage_per_cooldown% damage and heal %heal_per_cooldown% per turn of cooldown on the target.
details: Cooldowns driven up this way can exceed their normal maximum.
A landed attack deals %bonus_damage_per_cooldown% extra damage and heals this unit %heal_per_cooldown% for every turn of cooldown the target is carrying.
Since the drain itself piles those cooldowns up, every exchange makes the next one worth more.
